title: Compliance Request Orchestrator: residency-aware audit kits and smart questionnaire triage
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an orchestrator and UX flow that automates customer compliance requests end-to-end: triage inbound questionnaire requests, assemble residency- and retention-aware audit kits (DPA clauses, logs, export bundles), and surface a single downloadable artifact plus follow-up checklist. The feature must integrate with the Residency Config service and the Evidence Exporter, support template-based questionnaires, and provide clear operator visibility (console+events) for legal/CS teams. Focus on reducing manual effort for audit requests and lowering turnaround time while preserving auditable trails for regulated customers.
acceptance_criteria: Inbound compliance request (questionnaire or audit ticket) can be created via Console form or API and appears in the Compliance Orchestrator queue
Orchestrator uses customer's residency and retention profile to include correct data residency statements and log snapshots in generated audit kit
Questionnaire triage uses rule engine templates to map common questions to pre-populated evidence artifacts (configs, screenshots, logs, DPA clauses) with >70% automation for standard questionnaires
Generated audit kit is an annotated ZIP bundle with manifest, signed metadata, and a human-readable summary; bundle download link expires and is audited
Operator panel in Console shows request status, automated items included, manual follow-ups required, and a link to the exported artifact; events are trackable in the Audit Log
Legal/CS can kick off a re-run to include new retention snapshots; runs are idempotent and produce consistent manifests for repeatability
